name: IPO Terminal Evidence Engine
purpose: Evidence-first IPO analysis framework. This file is a knowledge/configuration layer, not copied editorial content.
principles: Official exchange and regulatory records outrank aggregators.
GMP is unofficial and must never be the sole reason for an IPO decision.
Missing data reduces confidence; it does not become a guessed value.
Separate listing-pop signals from long-term business quality.
Every positive or negative conclusion should be traceable to an available field or source.
A strong score with weak evidence should be shown as low confidence.
IPO Terminal should explain why an IPO fits a strategy rather than simply saying Apply or Avoid.
future_evidence: DRHP/RHP extracted risk factors and issue-objective text
GMP daily history and source consensus
Promoter pledge and related-party indicators when available
User-supplied analyst videos, podcasts and transcripts

training_policy.rule: User-supplied educational material should influence the framework only after attribution and evidence review; it should not overwrite official company facts.
